invention.ref: Sidney Rosenthal in Richmond Hill, New York invents the 'Magic Marker', a wool-felt wick pen writing on all surfaces
invention.ref_zh: 纽约里士满山的西德尼·罗森塔尔发明毛毡毛细吸管笔头 Magic Marker，可在纸张、金属与玻璃等几乎所有材质表面书写

patent.ref: Lee Newman patents an early felt-tipped marking pen in the United States (US Patent 946,149)
patent.ref_zh: 李·纽曼在美国取得早期毛毡头记号笔专利（US946149）

mass_production.ref: Speedry Chemical Products begins manufacturing the Magic Marker in New York
mass_production.ref_zh: 斯皮德里化学品公司在纽约正式量产并销售 Magic Marker

popularization.ref: Yukio Horie of Tokyo Stationery Company (Pentel) invents the modern acrylic fiber-tip Sign Pen, Tokyo, Japan
popularization.ref_zh: 日本东京文具公司（派通 Pentel）的堀江幸夫发明现代合成腈纶纤维笔尖签名笔（Sign Pen），迅速风靡全球办公室与画室

locations.place_label_zh: 美国纽约皇后区里士满山
locations.place_label_en: Richmond Hill, Queens, New York, USA

sources.title: The History of the Marker — Pen Heaven

summary_zh: 1952 年纽约罗森塔尔发明毛毡头 Magic Marker；1962 年日本东京文具的堀江幸夫研制出现代合成纤维签名笔（Pentel），随后荧光笔与白板笔风靡全球。
summary_en: In 1952 Sidney Rosenthal developed the felt-tip Magic Marker in New York. Yukio Horie's 1962 acrylic fiber-tip Sign Pen in Tokyo popularized the modern marker for office and art worldwide.
